args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This causes `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` to return `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Fix
Changed the rounding mode in `src/money.py` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the FIN-212 requirement stated in the docstring.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even`.
